name: Analyzing Business Models
description: Diagnose businesses, products, personal brands, services, courses, consulting offers, and projects with the Business Model Canvas to evaluate sustainability, weak links, and North Star metrics tied to revenue.

business_description.description: Business, product, service, course, content product, consulting offer, personal brand, or project description.

product_or_offer.description: What is sold or delivered, including product, service, course, subscription, consulting package, or content product.

customer_segments.description: Who buys, who uses, who decides, and what customer segment is being served.

revenue_streams.description: Subscription, one-time sales, consulting fees, course fees, advertising, commissions, licensing, or other revenue streams.

cost_structure.description: People, tools, ads, suppliers, time, platform fees, fixed costs, variable costs, and key expenses.

key_resources.description: People, knowledge, systems, audience, data, partnerships, brand assets, operational capabilities, or platform dependencies.

rules: Do not fabricate revenue, cost, market size, or customer data.
Mark missing revenue or cost information as assumptions or required follow-up data.
Do not present strategic diagnosis as guaranteed financial results.
If no revenue stream or cost information exists, ask for missing data or provide a hypothesis-only diagnosis.
